title: Why Moisture Sends Sandshrew to a Volcano
premise: When moisture wrinkles Sandshrew’s skin, it heads to a volcano and dries itself on geothermal heat.
audiencePromise: See how Sandshrew turns a moisture problem into a volcanic drying routine.
openLoop: How can a volcano fix Sandshrew’s wrinkled skin?
payoff: The strange detour ends with Sandshrew dry instead of wrinkled.
engagementQuestion: Dry sand or geothermal heat: which would you choose?

voice.instructions: Speak with dry, urgent curiosity. Start sharply, build tension as moisture disrupts Sandshrew’s dry life, then slow slightly on the geothermal reveal. Keep every line crisp and natural.

scenes.headline: DRYNESS IS HOME
scenes.narration: Its body is dry, and it lives in arid places far from water.

scenes.caption: GEOTHERMAL HEAT
